title: Cerebras says latest offering is 'fastest AI accelerator in the industry' as it takes aim at Nvidia
title_zh: Cerebras 表示，最新产品是“业界最快的人工智能加速器”，目标是英伟达
summary: Cerebras debuts a new rackscale system it says is the fastest AI accelerator in the industry.
summary_zh: Cerebras 推出了一种新的机架规模系统，据称这是业内最快的人工智能加速器。

title: Goldman Sachs Bets Big on Real Estate in Latest Deal
title_zh: 高盛在最新交易中大力投资房地产
summary: On Tuesday, the New York firm said it was making yet another asset-management acquisition: LCN Capital Partners.
summary_zh: 周二，这家纽约公司表示正在进行另一项资产管理收购：LCN Capital Partners。

title: KKR Makes $9 Billion Takeover Bid for Natural-Gas and Electricity Distributor
title_zh: KKR 出价 90 亿美元收购天然气和电力分销商
summary: Natural-gas and electricity distributor  UGI  recently received a roughly $9 billion takeover offer from  KKR  according to people familiar with the matter. The private-equity firm offered to buy UGI for $42.50 a share, the people said.
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，天然气和电力分销商 UGI 最近收到 KKR 约 90 亿美元的收购要约。知情人士称，这家私募股权公司提出以每股 42.50 美元的价格收购 UGI。

title: What Nvidia's $500 billion Wall Street deal signals about the AI boom
title_zh: Nvidia 5000 亿美元的华尔街交易预示着人工智能的繁荣
summary: Nvidia and six of the world's largest investment firms announced plans last week to channel more than $500 billion (€433bn) into AI infrastructure, an arrangement designed to let tech companies build data centres without loading the cost onto their own balance sheets.View on e...
summary_zh: 英伟达和全球六家最大的投资公司上周宣布计划将超过 5000 亿美元（4330 亿欧元）投入人工智能基础设施，这一安排旨在让科技公司在不将成本计入自己的资产负债表的情况下建设数据中心。

title: Target the Red-Hot Spin-Off and Merger Space With These ETFs
title_zh: 通过这些 ETF 瞄准炙手可热的分拆和合并空间
summary: Spin-offs and mergers can lead to major movement for share prices, but accessing these scenarios can be challenging for investors; these ETFs can help.
summary_zh: 分拆和合并可能会导致股价大幅波动，但了解这些情况对投资者来说可能具有挑战性；这些 ETF 可以提供帮助。
